card.fact_statement: Labour Minister Yolanda Díaz introduced paid climate leave in response to the 2024 Spanish floods.
card.source_span: Labour Minister Yolanda Díaz introduced a new system of "paid climate leave", which would allow workers to stay at home for up to four days during weather emergencies.
